blocks.text: “If we have nothing good to say, just keep it to ourselves :((“ Filipino actress and singer Ashtine Olviga called out netizens who made fun of an Alex Eala statue after the creator and owner apologized because some viewers felt it did not closely resemble the athlete. The actress also added that people became too bold to share their opinions, implying that some of them are not worth sharing. The viral statue of the Filipino athlete, placed in an ecofarm and resort in Cavite, went viral because people kept mocking and making fun of how it looked. Because of the public […]...
